source_batch.unit_label: BRBL C U01: Integrated Ombudsman Scheme 2021 (30 June 2026 snapshot) — Distinguish Ombudsman roles, receipt channels, representation and the scope of powers

facts.locator: printed pp.225–226; PDF page = printed page + 19
facts.statement: Courseware describes officers, tenure, location, CRPC and complaint entry.

RBI appoints its officers for up to three years at a time; locations/sittings and CRPC receipt/forwarding are specified. Clause8 distinguishes powers and dispute amount from compensation limits. Authorised representative excludes an advocate, subject to clause10 exception for an advocate who is the aggrieved person.

payload.title: A receipt channel is not an eligibility decision
payload.core_explanation_md:
The 2021 scheme provides online registration through the designated portal and electronic or physical submission to CRPC; complaints received directly at RBI offices are to be forwarded for further action. Proper routing and receipt do not themselves decide whether a complaint is maintainable. Keep acknowledgement, initial scrutiny and merits decisions separate.

RBI appoints the Ombudsman and Deputy Ombudsman from its officers, for a term not exceeding three years at a time. The scheme distinguishes their powers, including the Deputy role in specified closures and facilitated settlements. The statutory role should not be inferred from a job title used in an internal bank escalation.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a receipt acknowledgement prove that the complaint meets every maintainability condition?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Receipt and routing are different from scrutiny and the merits decision.

payload.title: Representation and the amount in dispute need separate checks
payload.core_explanation_md:
A complaint can be made personally or through a duly authorised representative under the scheme conditions. The advocate restriction has the stated exception when the advocate is the aggrieved person; it should not be turned into a rule that an advocate can never bring their own complaint.

Clause 8 also distinguishes the amount in dispute from the Ombudsman compensation powers. The compensation ceiling is not a universal ceiling on the disputed transaction amount. Equally, a large dispute does not guarantee that every requested compensation amount can be awarded. Identify the remedy requested and any rejection ground separately.

self_check.prompt_text: Can the compensation ceiling simply be used as the maximum amount of every underlying dispute?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The scheme separately addresses the dispute amount, compensation powers and rejection grounds.

payload.stem_md: A customer receives a CRPC acknowledgement and assumes there can be no further maintainability scrutiny. What distinction should the reviewer explain?

options.text_md: Every acknowledged complaint must result in the exact relief requested
options.explanation_md: Acknowledgement does not establish eligibility, deficiency or relief.

options.text_md: Routing is a substitute for all complaint information
options.explanation_md: The scheme still requires the applicable information and conditions.

options.text_md: Receipt/routing, initial scrutiny and the later merits process are separate
options.explanation_md: An acknowledgement establishes receipt rather than a final admissibility decision.

options.text_md: Only a postal complaint can ever be scrutinised
options.explanation_md: The scheme recognises the stated electronic and online modes as well.

payload.correct_explanation_md: An acknowledgement establishes receipt rather than a final admissibility decision.

payload.stem_md: An advocate seeks to lodge a complaint about their own service grievance as the aggrieved customer. A clerk rejects it solely because advocates cannot represent anyone under the scheme. What qualification matters?

options.text_md: Professional status alone guarantees an award
options.explanation_md: The complainant still must meet the scheme conditions and establish the relevant case.

options.text_md: The stated exception where the advocate is the aggrieved person
options.explanation_md: The representation restriction should not erase this express exception.

options.text_md: Require an unrelated customer to lodge the advocate personal grievance in their own name
options.explanation_md: The own-grievance exception does not require substituting another complainant for the aggrieved person.

options.text_md: Apply the non-advocate representative restriction without examining its own-grievance exception
options.explanation_md: The exception is part of the same admissibility provision and cannot be ignored.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The representation restriction should not erase this express exception.

Whole S04 unit/end questions inspected: printed pp.223–232 / PDF pp.242–251. Primary amended 2021 scheme clauses1–20, PDF pp.1–15 inspected, plus October2025 coverage notification. Statutory forms and source questions were not reused or cosmetically varied.

Teaching is expressly pinned to the 2021 framework as at30June2026. The 2026 scheme was notified16January2026 and commences1July2026 with express savings; no current-reference procedure is silently substituted. Independent review must reconcile exam treatment of pre-cutoff future-effective developments.

Source validity and author comparison do not establish independent approval. Individual coverage exclusions, further pre-cutoff instructions, factual maintainability and any live remedy require their own evidence.
Current contact addresses, portal operations and appointment rosters are not certified. This batch teaches the specified 2021 roles/channels, not present-day filing instructions.
